overview.text: Today's developments showcase significant progress across formal verification, agentic systems, and infrastructure scaling. Claude successfully proved security properties in compiled code across numerous open-source libraries, uncovering long-standing bugs and demonstrating the growing feasibility of automated software verification at scale. In foundation models, IQuest-Q1 introduces a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture tailored for agentic CLI systems, while new open artifacts like InternScience/Sage-A1.5 advance long-horizon scientific capabilities. Meanwhile, infrastructure scaling efforts continue to address high-demand workloads, as highlighted by OpenAI's work on serving massive user bases with improved read performance. Finally, safety evaluations remain critical, evidenced by Anthropic's investigation into alignment assessments regarding unsanctioned model behaviors during evaluations.

entries.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
entries.summary: Claude formally proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, it found bugs that had eluded detection for years.
entries.why: Demonstrates large-scale formal software verification using LLMs to find deep bugs in compiled open-source libraries.

entries.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
entries.summary: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera.
entries.why: Tackles temporal inference and factor-aware control for cinematic video generation from sparse inputs.

entries.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
entries.summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated).…
entries.why: Introduces a large sparse Mixture-of-Experts foundation model specifically designed to advance agentic CLI systems.

entries.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
entries.summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels.
entries.why: Provides budget-aware adaptation of intermediate features from frozen diffusion models for discriminative tasks.

entries.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
entries.summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models.
entries.why: Addresses fine-grained visual understanding challenges in unified multimodal models for local attributes and spatial relations.

entries.title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
entries.summary: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it.
entries.why: Explores co-adaptive hierarchical language modeling combining continuous semantic compression with balanced discrete generation.

entries.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
entries.summary: LLM memory is widely used in long-term conversation understanding. Agentic memory systems often use mutation, structural organization, learned retrieval strategies, or other complex operations.
entries.why: Compares complex agentic memory systems against naive RAG approaches in long-term conversation understanding.

entries.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.
entries.why: Details architectural strategies for scaling online storage and multi-tenancy to support massive user bases.

entries.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
entries.summary: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.
entries.why: Investigates unsanctioned model behaviors during safety evaluations to better understand alignment challenges.

entries.title: AI Is Getting Good at Math. Here’s Why.
entries.summary: AI models are solving more mathematical problems. A pattern is emerging in their successes that could help us predict which problems they’ll solve next.
entries.why: Analyzes emerging patterns in how AI models solve mathematical problems to predict future capabilities.
